name: 餐厨整墙柜·杂志级室内摄影（三缝对齐草稿；模型只画环境，冰箱用白底产品图原图贴入）
风格: An interior photograph for an architecture and lifestyle magazine: a real, lived-in dining kitchen with a full-height wall of built-in cabinetry in low-sheen oak veneer. Shot on a full-frame camera with a 40mm lens at eye level, 3:4 vertical, straight verticals.

光线: Soft overcast daylight from the window on the right, brightest near the glass and falling off gently along the cabinet wall toward the left. Neutral white balance, soft open shadows that keep material detail.
